about: Workflows a push to feat-cmux-next starts that no pull request into it can reach (tests/test_ci_post_merge_checks.py). kind check: a verdict about the code, to move onto pull requests. kind publish: a deploy, a publish, a bot or a probe of a live system. The list and check_budget only shrink; the target for checks is 0.

acpmux-sim-sweep.yml.why: the large seed sweep; pull requests run only a fixed small window in cmux-tui-spec

app-ffi-release.yml.why: publishes the app FFI release from the base

app-ffi-repin.yml.why: a bot that re-pins the app FFI after a release

chief-evals.yml.why: scores Chief code after it lands; a regression shows only on the base

cloud-devbox-image-rebake.yml.why: rebakes the Cloud devbox image after its inputs land

cloud-machine-count-probe.yml.why: a probe of live staging machines, not of the change

cloud-vm-image-roll.yml.why: rolls the Cloud VM image after its inputs land

cmux-art-publish.yml.why: publishes art assets from the base

cmux-browser-host-chromium.yml.why: builds and publishes the Chromium host from the base

cmux-browser-host-release.yml.why: publishes the browser host release from the base

cmux-mobile-ffi.yml.why: fmt, clippy, tests and the xcframework for the mobile FFI run on push paths only

cmux-next-base-autofix.yml.why: a bot that repairs mechanical reds by committing on the base

cmux-next-base-tier-kick.yml.why: starts the base Mac tier, whose Swift tests pull requests run only under full-ci

cmux-next-chromium-staleness.yml.why: reports how stale the Chromium pin is; no verdict on a change

cmux-next-daemon-macos-shadow.yml.why: the macOS-only daemon tests (Keychain, Seatbelt, idle wakeups) run on the base only

cmux-next-dev-kick.yml.why: starts the DEV build for a landing

cmux-next-fast-tier-seed.yml.why: seeds the fast tier's cache from the base

cmux-next-generated-catch-up.yml.why: a bot that regenerates files on the base

cmux-next-package-deps-heal.yml.why: a bot that heals package dependency pins on the base

cmux-next-terminal.yml.why: the Rust and Swift terminal suites run on every push and on no pull request

cmux-next-tip-test-compile.yml.why: compiles the Swift test targets at the tip; the pull request compile is a separate advisory job

cmux-next-web-bundle-publish.yml.why: publishes the web bundle from the base

cmux-next-web-lint.yml.why: web lint fails here on push; cmux-next-fast-gates.yml re-creates it for pull requests

cmux-next-web.yml.why: the base's web verdict, coalesced; pull requests get theirs from ci.yml's copy of the jobs

cmux-rd-windows.yml.why: the Windows host selftest and the Windows-to-Mac live proof (#42833, #42911); the proof needs the ios-e2e environment, which pull request events do not reach, and no PR job runs Windows under steps.toml's pr_jobs budget (cmuxterm-hq#10846)

cmux-tui-artifacts.yml.why: its daemon tests gate the nightly and run only after the branch push, on no pull request trigger

cmux-tui-headless-debug.yml.why: publishes the headless debug daemon from the base

cmux-tui-tree-request.yml.why: requests a cmux-tui tree publish for a landing

fresh-chief-eval.yml.why: a scheduled eval of the live Chief, a score and not a verdict on a change

gateway-e2e.yml.why: the inference gateway end-to-end run starts on push paths only

git-mirror-bundle.yml.why: publishes the git mirror bundle the fleet clones from

internal-token-prod.yml.why: deploys the production internal token setting

internal-token-staging.yml.why: deploys the staging internal token setting

ios-internal-nightly-trigger.yml.why: starts the iPhone internal build for a landing

mobile-worker-dev-deploy.yml.why: deploys the mobile Worker to development

pair-machine-join-check.yml.why: the pairing join check starts on push paths only

whats-new-gallery.yml.why: publishes the What's New gallery pictures
